alignment: same physical placement, topology and service condition
same actual token/cache/chunk/head boundary and selected logical work
rank-local timestamp origin subtraction without time stretching
operator/type/shape/layer semantic keys, explicit verified fusion/rename mappings
logical invocation and collective IDs; physical stream IDs mapped to roles
capture_contract: complete all-rank/all-stream Chrome X GPU events
explicit rank/device/clock source and window selector
predeclared representative matched windows, no reuse of identical file/window
overhead checks, dropped-event accounting and source correlation

metrics.prefill: rank-local selected window wall, work sum, busy/idle union; separate imported native statistics
metrics.operator: event count, work and share, union/wall coverage, exclusive exposure, logical invocation spans
metrics.communication: matched logical collective/group/op/dtype/payload, work/union, compute overlap and exposed time; pure wire time unknown
metrics.streams: distinct physical-stream overlap; explicit role union and role-pair intersection
metrics.migration: absolute work increase vs exposure increase with stable work vs relative share only; no confirmed causal bottleneck

insufficient_evidence.missing_rank_clipped_dropped_unknown_map: partial; retain independent observations, suppress deltas and summaries
insufficient_evidence.mixed_fused_kernel: keep total interval; unresolved compute/communication split is null
insufficient_evidence.unknown_absence: unmatched; never zero-fill a missing operator
insufficient_evidence.missing_native: trace hypotheses only; no service gain claim
insufficient_evidence.topology_change: rank-local ratios require a new workload normalization contract; use deployment module

native_link: optional original kernel evaluation bundle plus candidate ID; revalidate testing, deployment, deep analysis, precision and all native rounds; never use profile time as promotion
not_implemented: live profiler or binary vendor trace reader
cross-host clock synchronization and collective arrival skew
causal critical-path DAG or optimization executor
